metadata.description: Personal, battle-tested Claude Code skills — house patterns so new projects don't reinvent the wheel.

plugins.name: coding-style
plugins.description: Cross-domain code + environment conventions, independent of any app stack: lint-format (language-agnostic tooling floor), brevity (a line must inform or go), ts-style (TypeScript/JavaScript house style), svelte (Svelte + SvelteKit style), and fish (Eetu's default shell).

plugins.name: homebrew
plugins.description: House patterns for self-hosted homebrew web apps: shared look (halo-design), frontend (spa-frontend), backend (rust-axum), and the assembly+deploy orchestrator (sibling-app).

plugins.name: diagnosis
plugins.description: How to investigate a fault without inventing a cause: root-cause (every explanation is a hypothesis with a named falsifying test, Occam's razor ranks rather than decides, coincidence is the default suspect, and "cause unknown" is a legitimate ending).

plugins.name: creative-coding
plugins.description: Generative / canvas visual effects independent of any app stack: ascii-artist (animated ASCII art — masks, density ramps, particle systems, fbm-noise fields, pseudo-3D, performance rules, single-file delivery).

plugins.name: game-maker
plugins.description: Building blocks for small 2.5D pixel-art games, grown as games need them, most of them used through @anarkisti/korpi: dab-sprites (hand-drawn art in dab, the core tool), world-clock, posed-pixels, wind-and-springs, procedural-plants, pixel-brushes, sky-and-weather, depth-and-lod, breaking-structures (masonry that wears, breaks, falls and piles), and game-workbench (the dev loop).
